title: AI Agents for Nutrition Brands: Assemble Product and Batch-Document Requests
summary: A Genie matches a buyer's product and lot request to approved documents in NetSuite and Postgres, checks version and sharing rights, then drafts the reply.
body_markdown:
## The operating decision


A nutrition-brand Genie can find and assemble approved product and batch documents for a specific request. It should verify the product, lot, document version, and sharing permission before proposing a response. The job retrieves existing evidence; it does not generate a certificate of analysis or independently certify a product’s quality.


Explore the complete[nutrition and supplements integration and automation hub](https://www.stacksync.com/industry/cpg/nutrition-supplements) for the systems and processes around this guide.
